top_signals.title: Goldman: Diesel prices set to stay high through 2027 as refineries struggle to meet demand
top_signals.summary: Goldman Sachs says tight refinery capacity could keep diesel prices elevated through 2027, with high margins needed to curb demand and rebuild inventories.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Sushi Restaurants Put on Tuna Carving Dinner Shows
top_signals.summary: Sushi restaurants are swapping soft music and carefully plated fish for the spectacle of breaking down 200-pound bluefin tuna in front of paying customers. Some are charging well into five figures to buy out the restaurant for the night. Sunny Kim reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.summary: The European Union will look to appoint a market operator to help the bloc procure energy as it struggles with a second price crisis in less than five years.

top_signals.title: Public companies produce most U.S. crude oil and natural gas
top_signals.summary: Publicly traded companies represent a tiny share of the total number of companies producing crude oil and natural gas in the United States, but they make up a large share of U.S. production. In 2025, publicly traded companies accounted for just 2% of about 12,000 oil and natural gas producers but produced 68% of the crude oil and natural gas in the Lower 48 states.
